# MPT API 开放平台

> MPT API 开放平台：免费短视频生成 API。注册后获得 API Key，提交视频主题即可用 Pexels / Pixabay 免费素材、Edge TTS 配音和自动字幕合成短视频。全程无需大模型，完全免费不限次数。

Updated: 2026-10-02. Based on MoneyPrinterTurbo hosted edition v1.3.7. Script <= 1500 characters. Video <= 180 seconds. Completion state is `complete`. New generation only.

## Core pages

- [首页](__ORIGIN__/): 产品介绍与快速开始
- [套餐定价](__ORIGIN__/pricing): 价格为 0，不限次数
- [API 文档](__ORIGIN__/docs): x-api-key 认证、提交、轮询、下载
- [免费注册](__ORIGIN__/register): 注册即得 API Key
- [OpenAPI](__ORIGIN__/openapi.json): 机器可读规格
- [调用摘要](__ORIGIN__/api/saas): JSON 能力清单
- [完整说明](__ORIGIN__/llms-full.txt): 产品事实与 curl
- [Markdown 摘要](__ORIGIN__/llms.md): 给模型的短摘要
- [AI 爬虫策略](__ORIGIN__/ai.txt): 允许公开页，禁止控制台与 /api/
- [humans.txt](__ORIGIN__/humans.txt): 站点维护信息
- [security.txt](__ORIGIN__/.well-known/security.txt): 安全联系

## Facts

- Price: 0, unlimited. LLM: disabled. Auth: x-api-key or ?api_key=
- Sources: Pexels, Pixabay. Voice: Edge TTS.
- Aspects: 9:16, 16:9, 1:1. Complete state: complete. Failed state: failed.
- Edit existing video: unsupported.

## API

POST __ORIGIN__/api/proxy/v1/videos with header `x-api-key`. Poll GET __ORIGIN__/api/proxy/v1/videos/{task_id} until `state=complete`.

## English

Free short-video generation API. Register for an `x-api-key`, POST a topic to `/api/proxy/v1/videos`, poll until `state=complete`. Pexels/Pixabay + Edge TTS. No LLM. Script <= 1500 characters, video <= 180 seconds. Timeline editing unsupported.
